image_prompt:
Make one high-fidelity website screenshot, exactly 1440x1100 px, desktop viewport, flat front-on view with no device frame, no perspective mockup and no browser chrome. It is the first screen of a new personal engineering portfolio for a Korean engineer named 김형준. The audience is CTOs and engineering leaders. Use the three reference images only for layout ideas and mood. Do not copy their brands, logos, wordmarks, project names, award lists, people, photos, screenshots or 3D objects. From the first reference (dark index portfolio), take the near-black page and the top header split into thin columns with small text lists. From the second reference (light rounded stage), take a large rounded light-grey panel that holds a dark editor-style timeline with a transport bar, a ruler and a row of rounded tiles, where the active tile lifts above the track. All text is Korean except the product names AgentWorkflow and Hero Pixel Studio and the letters QA, API, CLI, Wiki. Draw all Korean text cleanly in a modern Korean sans-serif in the style of Pretendard, spelled exactly as given below.

PALETTE: page background #0B0B0C. Primary text #F2F1EE. Muted text #8E8C87. Hairlines are white at 12% opacity. Stage panel #E7E5E0 with dark text #18181A. Timeline module #1B1B1E. Signal orange #FF5A1F is the only accent, used for the active step, the playhead and the primary button. Lime #B8F04A appears only as small completed-step dots. Pinkish red #FF3D6E marks the QA defect and its return path. Soft blue #7AA7FF marks human decision points. No other colours. No purple anywhere, no neon, no glow, no light leaks, no decorative gradients, no background patterns, no watermark text.

ICONS: all control icons are simple thin outline icons of one consistent family (Phosphor regular style), about 18 to 20 px, in the colour of the surrounding text. No other icons.

HEADER (y 24 to 120, 32px side margins, 15px text, six columns on a 12-column grid): column 1 '김형준' in medium weight. Column 2 'AI 워크플로 엔지니어'. Column 3 is the heading '하는 일', with an indented list underneath: 'AI 업무 워크플로 설계' / '멀티 에이전트 검수·QA 체계' / '서버·라이브 운영'. HERO (y 150 to 410): at top left, a small pill with a hairline border and muted 12px text: '설명용 데모 · 실제 AI 실행 아님'. WORKFLOW STAGE (y 440 to 1040, x 32 to 1408): one large flat light-grey panel #E7E5E0 with a 28px radius and nothing drawn in its background. This is a real interactive UI component with clear, readable, working-looking controls, not an illustration. RULES: no human face or portrait anywhere in this screenshot. No logos of any company or AI provider. No invented metrics, percentages, multipliers, time savings, star ratings or award badges. No fake terminal or code window. No stock photos, no 3D blobs, no decorative illustrations, no decorative icons, no giant background words. Generous negative space, crisp hairlines, premium editorial engineering feel, bold but calm, every label legible.

visual_contract.canvas: Compare at 1440x1100 desktop, DPR 1. Page background #0B0B0C. 32px outer side margins (content width 1376). 12-column grid, 24px gutters. Native document scroll, no scroll hijacking.
visual_contract.type: Pretendard Variable (self-hosted from the npm package 'pretendard', OFL), with the fallback system-ui, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic'. Body 17/1.6 weight 400. Header 15/1.35. Hero h1 clamp(44px, 5.3vw, 76px)/1.04 weight 700, letter-spacing -0.04em, word-break keep-all. Section titles 28/1.2 weight 700, -0.02em. Tile label 26 weight 700, tile caption 12 weight 500. Counters use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. No monospace terminal styling. Icons: @phosphor-icons/react (MIT), weight 'regular', 20px in controls and 14px in badges, colour currentColor. Import only the non-deprecated *Icon export names (PlayIcon, PauseIcon, ArrowCounterClockwiseIcon, SkipForwardIcon, CheckIcon, WarningIcon, UserFocusIcon, CaretLeftIcon, CaretRightIcon, XIcon, plus the functional status/résumé icons listed in revision_notes); the bare names are @deprecated aliases in 2.1.10. No other icon sources, no handcrafted icon SVG.
desktop_layout_1440x1100: Header y24–120: 6 columns (spans 2/2/3/3/1/1) in Gil style. The heading lines are --text and the list items are indented 16px. '프로필' is an in-page anchor. '연락' is a button that opens the contact sheet. Not sticky. After 400px of scroll, a compact 56px sticky bar fades in with the name, section links and 연락.

Hero y150–410: (revised: no demo-label pill; the career arc line sits at the top.) The h1 spans columns 1–8. Support text and buttons span columns 9–12, bottom-aligned with the h1 baseline. Primary button: flat --signal background with --ink text. Secondary button has a 1px --line border and --text text. Both 48px tall, 22px horizontal padding.

Stage y440–1040: section#workflow, flat --stage background (no background artwork or watermark), radius 28, 32px padding. Title row at the top (label '01' + title on the left, segmented control on the right, each segment 40px tall). Track module centred, 1200 wide, --track background, radius 20, --shadow-track. Inside the track: transport row 56px (play/pause toggle, reset, 다음 단계, counter '실행 n / total' + '재작업 포함' hint when failOn, divider, failOn switch, status chip, '설명용 실행'), ruler 28px, then the tile row (7×148px tiles, 12px gaps, 120px tall). The ruler always has exactly 7 ticks, one per phase tile, captioned '단계'; it never shows execution ticks. The counter always shows execution ticks. The playhead sits on the phase tick of the current execution step. Completed tiles carry a --pass dot with Phosphor Check. The current tile uses --tile-active, translates -10px, scales 1.04, gets --shadow-lift and may overlap the track's top edge; when its latest outcome is a defect it carries a --fault badge with Phosphor Warning and '결함 발견'. Human markers are Phosphor UserFocus in --human with caption. The fault arc is a functional SVG connector path (stroke --fault, dashed, arrowhead at the target tile), positioned from tile geometry, not artwork. Below the track is a 2-column split: phase detail (span 7) and history log (span 5, max-height 180px, scrolls internally, newest entry at the bottom with auto-scroll).

Works index y1050–1100: hairline at y1050, then label '02' + title '작업 사례' on the left and, on the same baseline, a text index of the 4 case titles (15px --muted, hairline separators, each an anchor to its card). No card or thumbnail is visible within 1100px.
below_fold: 02 작업 사례: a curved horizontal rail of exactly 4 cards, each 600×520, 24px gaps, native horizontal scroll with scroll-snap plus prev/next icon buttons (CaretLeft/CaretRight, 44px). The container has perspective 1600px. Each card gets rotateY based on its horizontal distance from the viewport centre (±10deg max, computed with a single rAF on scroll/resize, no scroll-jacking). Card = --ink-2, radius 20, hairline border. Structure top to bottom: header bar 56px ('01'–'04' + title), evidence image area 600×264, body with the one-line claim, tags and a '자세히 보기' affordance with ArrowUpRight. Evidence image area: the three flow diagrams sit on --mat with 20px padding, object-fit contain; the Hero Pixel Studio editor capture sits on --ink-2, object-fit cover, object-position 50% 0 (top of the editor). Images are the genuine source files listed in assets, never redrawn, recoloured or replaced by CSS art.

SUPERSEDED by revision_notes.resume_update: 03 프로필 short bio and 04 연락 one-liner. Current order below the cases: 03 소개 (#about), 04 회사 경력 (#career), 05 학력·역량 (#skills). Footer shows only the demo label and name.

03 소개: grid 260px | 1fr. Left column: the original portrait myface4.png (object-fit cover, object-position 50% 30%, radius 16, unaltered pixels) and below it the 연락처 slot list (이메일 / 전화 / 외부 프로필 with Phosphor EnvelopeSimpleIcon / PhoneIcon / LinkSimpleIcon, empty values drawn as a dashed 32px slot reading '준비 중'). 04 회사 경력: Gil-style dark index. Section head with lede '게임 QA에서 서버 개발로, 이후 창업과 서비스 운영까지'. Ordered list, newest first, each row a 3-column grid (196px period | 300px company h3 + role + optional note | responsibilities list + tag chips) separated by hairlines. A 1px vertical connector with a 9px dot per row runs on the left as a functional order marker; only the ongoing entry has a filled --signal dot and a '진행 중' chip. 05 학력·역량: two columns 5fr | 7fr. Left '학력': two rows (GraduationCapIcon, date, school, major · degree). Right '활용 가능 기술': six group rows (label | wrap of tag chips). No meters, stars, percentages or ordering by proficiency.
visual_contract.mobile_390: Header collapses to '김형준' + a '메뉴' button that opens a full-screen sheet holding the column lists. h1 44px. Buttons stack full width. The stage panel has radius 20 and 16px padding. The segmented control is full width. The transport bar is sticky at the top of the stage while the stage is in view; the counter and switch wrap to a second row. The phase timeline turns vertical: a left ruler line with 7 phase rows, each 64px tall, and the tile turns into a row card. The QA→개발 return is drawn as a left-side dashed bracket. In 독립 병렬 mode the lanes A/B/C show as three stacked collapsible groups that merge into a shared Wiki→통합 block. Phase detail and history become stacked tabs. The works index becomes a vertical list; the case rail becomes horizontal scroll-snap at 86vw with no 3D tilt, header bar 48px, image area aspect 16/8. Every tap target is at least 44px.
visual_contract.tablet_768_1100: The track scrolls horizontally inside the panel (overflow-x auto, scroll-snap), with the tiles kept at 148px and the ruler scrolling with them. The header becomes 3 columns. Case cards 520 wide.
visual_contract.parity_notes: The implementation must match the target at 1440x1100 for these: header columns, hero split, the stage panel starting near y440, 7 tiles in one row with QA lifted and showing the 결함 발견 badge, ruler with exactly 7 phase ticks and playhead on tick 5, counter '실행 05 / 10' with '재작업 포함', play icon (paused), failure arc 5→3 visible, two-column detail/history with 5 history entries, works title and 4-entry text index at the bottom. The target state is mode 순차, failOn on, status paused, cursor at execution step 5 of 10 (QA 1차 결함 just recorded), tiles 1–4 completed, tile 5 current with fault, tiles 6–7 pending, selected = QA. Expose a ?state=target query to reproduce it deterministically.

interaction_contract.model: A pure reducer drives everything (no timers inside the reducer). State: mode (direct | sequential | parallel), failOn boolean, status (idle | playing | paused | done), cursor (index into the generated execution plan), selected (phaseId or null), history (entries). The execution plan is generated deterministically from mode and failOn and is unit-testable. Each plan step carries {phaseIndex (0–6, the tile/ruler tick), phase, round, outcome, lane?}. Two distinct quantities are kept apart everywhere: the 7 logical phases (tiles, ruler ticks, mobile rows) and the execution steps (counter '실행 n / total', history entries).

plans.direct: 요청 → Master AI 직접 처리 → 응답 (3 execution steps, counter '실행 n / 3'). The 7 phase tiles and the ruler dim to 30% and get the caption '이 경로에서는 생략'. A 3-node lane replaces the tile row, with the caption '단순 요청은 단계를 늘리지 않습니다'. failOn is disabled with the hint 'QA 단계가 없는 경로'.
plans.sequential: Phases 기획→검수→개발→검수→QA→Wiki→통합. failOn off: 7 execution steps, counter total 7, phase index equals step index. failOn on: 기획, 검수, 개발, 검수, QA(1차 결함), 개발(수정), 검수(재검수), QA(2차 통과), Wiki, 통합 = 10 execution steps, counter total 10 and '재작업 포함' shown. The ruler stays at 7 phase ticks; during steps 6–8 the playhead travels back along the arc to phase 3 and forward again, and tiles 3–5 show the '재작업 1회' badge. Target state = step 5 of 10.
plans.parallel: Master AI splits the work into independent lanes A/B/C (caption: '서로 의존하지 않는 작업만 병렬'). Each lane runs phases 1–5 (기획→검수→개발→검수→QA) in lockstep ticks, then a merge gate node between ruler ticks 5 and 6 leads to shared Wiki→통합. failOn off: 5 lane ticks + 병합 + Wiki + 통합 = 8 execution steps. failOn on: lane B fails QA and loops 개발→검수→QA (3 ticks) while lanes A and C show '병합 대기' at the gate, then 병합 + Wiki + 통합 = 11 execution steps. Ruler stays at 7 phase ticks. History labels each entry with its lane.

interaction_contract.history: Append-only during a run. Entry = {seq, lane?, phase, round, outcome: 완료 | 승인 | 결함 발견 | 수정 | 재검수 | 통과 | 기록 | 병합}. (Revised by explicit user request: no '(설명용)' suffix on entries.) Review steps say '교차 검토: 작성 AI ↔ 다른 제공사 검토 AI'. There is no mandatory human step at reviews. Human markers appear only on 기획 (범위 판단 필요 시) and 통합 (배포 권한), and they say '필요 시'. The recovery shows a '재작업 1회' badge. Reset clears the history. Changing mode or failOn resets the run with a 150ms crossfade.
interaction_contract.transport: Play/Pause is one toggle button (aria-pressed; Phosphor Play when idle/paused, Pause when playing; accessible label 재생/일시정지). Steps advance every 1100ms via setTimeout in an effect and are cleared on pause/unmount/visibilitychange hidden. At the end: status done, the button becomes '다시 실행'. Reset (ArrowCounterClockwise): idle, cursor -1. '다음 단계' (SkipForward) steps manually and stays available in every motion mode. Status chip text: idle '대기', playing '실행 중', paused '일시정지' (+ ' · QA n차 결함' when the latest entry is a defect), done '완료'. No global keyboard shortcuts.
interaction_contract.explorer: The tile row is a role=tablist with roving tabindex. ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus, Home/End jump, Enter/Space select. Each tile is a role=tab with aria-controls pointing to the detail panel. Clicking or tapping a tile pauses a playing run and shows that phase's detail without changing the cursor. A '실행 위치로' link snaps the selection back to the cursor. Resuming play makes the selection follow the cursor again. Tile states are expressed in text as well as colour (aria-label like 'QA, 현재 단계, 결함 발견' / '완료' / '대기' / '재작업').
interaction_contract.mode_switch: role=radiogroup, arrow keys change the option and apply it immediately. The selected segment indicator slides (transform translateX, 280ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)). Lanes in parallel mode expand with a FLIP height animation.
interaction_contract.motion: The playhead translates between phase ticks (transform only, 420ms ease-out). The current tile lifts (translateY -10px, scale 1.04, 320ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1)). Completed tiles get the lime dot pop (scale 0→1, 200ms). On failure the tile shakes 2px for 240ms, then the fault arc draws via stroke-dashoffset (500ms), then the playhead travels back along the arc. Section entry: IntersectionObserver adds .in-view, giving opacity 0→1 and translateY 24→0 over 600ms, staggered 60ms, once only. Hover/focus: buttons brighten, tiles raise 4px, cards straighten to rotateY 0 and lift. Focus-visible ring is 2px --signal with 3px offset on dark and 2px --stage-ink on the light panel.
interaction_contract.cases: The cards are buttons with aria-haspopup=dialog. Hover or focus: the evidence image scales 1.03 within its mat and the claim line slides up. Activation opens a modal dialog (native <dialog> with showModal, aria-labelledby). When document.startViewTransition is supported, the card image and title morph via view-transition-name into the dialog header. Otherwise the dialog scales from 0.96 and fades in from the card's origin over 360ms. Focus moves to the dialog title, Tab is trapped, Esc and the close button (Phosphor X) close it, focus returns to the originating card, and the background is inert with scroll locked. Dialog content: problem, my role, structure (the same genuine source image at full width, zoomable to natural size, horizontally scrollable on mobile), what was verified, limits/notes. No metrics.
interaction_contract.reduced_motion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all transforms/transitions become instant or opacity-only ≤120ms. No shake, no arc draw (the arc appears statically), no tilt on the card rail, no view-transition morph, and section entry is visible immediately. Autoplay still works only when the user presses play. Every state remains reachable via 다음 단계, tiles and the history. The state is fully conveyed by text.
interaction_contract.touch: Every tap target is at least 44px. The tablist is horizontally scrollable on tablet with scroll-snap, and taps never fire on drag (pointer movement threshold 8px). No custom swipe gestures that block native scroll.
interaction_contract.contact: (Revised for the latest user request.) The '연락' button (header, sticky bar, mobile menu) opens a small dialog titled '연락처' that renders the same empty slot list as 03 소개 (이메일 / 전화 / 외부 프로필, value '준비 중', note '연락처는 준비 중입니다. 입력되면 이 자리에 표시됩니다.') plus the close button. Values come from CONTACT.fields in src/content/resume.js and are empty strings; when the owner fills them they render as plain text only. No mailto, tel, social links, address, birthdate or downloadable resume/PDF anywhere in the DOM or bundle.
interaction_contract.privacy_meta: index.html includes <meta name="robots" content="noindex, noarchive">. The Vite server and preview headers set X-Robots-Tag: noindex, noarchive. No robots.txt Disallow, no sitemap, no analytics, no OG/SEO description copy, no external network requests (fonts and icons bundled locally).
interaction_contract.honesty: (Revised by explicit user request, overriding the old mandated notice.) No demo/illustrative disclaimer pill, transport note, footer note or display job title is rendered; the name '김형준' appears alone with no replacement title or warning. No API calls, no costs, no 'live/production' status, no timing figures. Case claims state only what the source images show.

assets.missing_handled_as_text: No case lacks a source image: all 4 cards use the genuine files above. The engineering background (게임 서버·라이브 운영 etc.) is profile text with no image. There are no typographic placeholder covers, CSS grid art or generated imagery.
assets.fonts: Pretendard Variable woff2 from the npm 'pretendard' package, self-hosted. The v2 NotoSansKR/YouandiModern fonts are not used. Icons from @phosphor-icons/react (MIT), bundled locally.
assets.no_new_assets: No new raster assets and no decorative CSS/SVG art (no watermark word, no grid covers, no background illustrations, no decorative gradients). Code renders only functional UI: buttons, segmented control, switch, tiles (flat fill with the --tile tonal control styling), ruler ticks, playhead, status dots/badges, and the fault arc as a functional SVG connector. All icons come from Phosphor.

revision_notes.page_order: User's latest explicit instruction overrides earlier layout and any section order below: 01 소개 (name 김형준 as the page's only h1, original photo, self-introduction) → 02 학력·역량 → 03 AgentWorkflow (hero explanation, now an h2 with unchanged styling, directly before the interactive stage) → 04 회사 경력 → 05 작업 사례 → footer. Header, sticky bar and mobile links follow this order. The 1440x1100 ?state=target first-screen stage position no longer applies; workflow phases, run numbering, dialog, rail and motion are unchanged.
revision_notes.resume_update: User asked that the page say who this person is (self-introduction, company history, education, skills) so it works as a résumé, with contact values left as empty slots for the owner to fill later; name and photo stay. Data source: the owner's latest résumé (companies, periods, roles, responsibilities, education, skills) and personal statement (career arc, values). All résumé data is centralised in src/content/resume.js; application-target headings, contact values, address, birthdate, gender and military info are excluded.
revision_notes.identity_on_first_screen: Intentional change to the 1440x1100 composition, chosen to keep parity: (1) header column 5 changes from the single link '프로필' to a Gil-style column headed '이력' listing anchors 소개 / 회사 경력 / 학력·역량 (same height as the neighbouring lists, so the header height is unchanged); (2) the hero meta row puts a career-arc line '게임 QA → 게임 서버·라이브 운영 → 인공지능학 석사 → 1인 창업·장기 계약 외주' (14px, last step in --text) to the right of the demo pill; (3) the hero aside gains a hairline '이력' link row (44px) above the support text. The aside stays shorter than the h1 block, so the hero height and the stage start (about y440) are unchanged; host must confirm in design-qa.
revision_notes.sticky_bar: Implemented from desktop_layout: after 400px of scroll (IntersectionObserver on a sentinel, no scroll listener) a 56px fixed bar (52px under 760px) fades/slides in with the name, all section links (AgentWorkflow, 작업 사례, 소개, 회사 경력, 학력·역량; horizontally scrollable on narrow screens) and 연락. Hidden state is inert. Anchors use scroll-margin-top = bar height + 16px; the mobile sticky transport sits at top = bar height.
revision_notes.motion_completed: Mode indicator: one dark indicator slides with translateX + width over 280ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), measured from the checked radio and re-measured by ResizeObserver; before measurement the checked radio keeps its own fill. Route/lane transition: when mode or failOn changes, the timeline area animates from its previous to its new height with opacity .4→1 (280ms, Web Animations API, overflow clipped only while running); equal heights get a 150ms fade only. QA emphasis: the current fault tile shakes 2px once (240ms, individual translate property so the lift transform is kept) and fault/rework badges pop once (220ms). No looping animation.
revision_notes.case_rail: Implemented the curved rail: cards min(600px, 84vw) wide, 24px gaps, native horizontal scroll with scroll-snap center and side padding (rail width - card width)/2 so every card can sit centred. A single rAF per scroll/resize writes --tilt (-1..1) per card; CSS maps it to rotateY(tilt × -8deg) inside perspective(1600px) only at min-width 761px with motion allowed (8deg instead of 10deg: the 600px cards read better with the smaller angle). Hover/focus straightens to 0deg and lifts 6px; the image scales 1.03. The centred card is 'active': full opacity (others .74), its index entry in the 02 text index is highlighted with an orange numeral and aria-current, and a '01 / 04' counter sits beside 44px CaretLeftIcon/CaretRightIcon prev/next buttons (aria-disabled at the ends). Index links centre the card inside the rail and focus it; keyboard focus on a card centres it. Card anatomy and the case dialog are unchanged.
revision_notes.icons_added: Functional icons used in the résumé and rail: EnvelopeSimpleIcon, PhoneIcon, LinkSimpleIcon (contact slot labels), GraduationCapIcon (education rows), ArrowRightIcon (in-page links), CaretLeftIcon/CaretRightIcon (rail). Existing status icons (CheckCircleIcon, CircleDashedIcon, GitMergeIcon, HourglassIcon, WarningCircleIcon, CaretDownIcon, ListIcon, ArrowsOutSimpleIcon) migrated to *Icon names.
revision_notes.still_open: Not done in this update: mobile detail/history tabs, SVG fault arc with stroke-dashoffset draw and playhead travel along the arc, case card header bar 56px anatomy.
